tool_schemas.name: list_incidents
tool_schemas.description: Lists incidents for the given workspace from the Datadog live API or from the cached resources store, applying optional free-text query, status, tags (AND), time window, sorting, and returning up to `limit` items plus an opaque `cursor` when another page is available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, enum values, malformed timestamps, `time_from` > `time_to`, or out-of-range `limit`; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace or selected connection and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the requested `connection_id` is not available in the workspace/default. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when live reads exceed configured rate limits for the workspace/connection.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to scope the Datadog tenant.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID to use; defaults to workspace default if omitted.

source.description: Whether to read from Datadog live API or from cached dd_resources.

query.description: Free-text search string to filter incidents (name/attributes/tags depending on source).

time_from.description: Start of time window for incident listing/filtering.

time_to.description: End of time window for incident listing/filtering.

limit.description: Maximum number of incidents to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_incident
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single incident by `incident_id` for the workspace, either live from Datadog or from the cached resources store, and returns the incident record if found. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs or `source`, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace/connection; raises NOT_FOUND when the workspace is missing, the connection is missing/unconfigured for the workspace, or the incident does not exist in the selected source. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when live reads exceed configured rate limits for the workspace/connection.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to scope the Datadog tenant.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID to use; defaults to workspace default if omitted.

source.description: Whether to read from Datadog live API or from cached dd_resources.

tool_schemas.name: get_metrics
tool_schemas.description: Executes a time-bounded Datadog metrics query for the workspace/connection and returns the resulting timeseries (respecting `interval_seconds` rollup and `max_points`), recording the execution and deduplicating identical requests when `idempotency_key` is provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, empty/invalid query, malformed timestamps, `time_from` > `time_to`, or non-positive `interval_seconds`/`max_points`; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace/connection and NOT_FOUND if the workspace is missing or no connection is configured/selected. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when query execution exceeds configured limits (rate/volume) for the workspace/connection.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to scope the Datadog tenant.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID to use; defaults to workspace default if omitted.

time_from.description: Start of the query time window.

time_to.description: End of the query time window.

interval_seconds.description: Rollup/interval in seconds for the metrics query.

max_points.description: Maximum number of points to return per timeseries.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key to deduplicate identical query executions.

tool_schemas.name: get_logs
tool_schemas.description: Searches Datadog logs over the provided time window and returns up to `limit` log events ordered by `sort`, along with an opaque `cursor` for fetching the next page; when `idempotency_key` is provided, identical searches are deduplicated and the recorded execution may be reused. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, invalid sort, malformed timestamps, `time_from` > `time_to`, or out-of-range `limit`; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace/connection and NOT_FOUND if the workspace is missing or the selected/default connection is unavailable. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when log search exceeds configured rate/volume limits for the workspace/connection.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to scope the Datadog tenant.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID to use; defaults to workspace default if omitted.

time_from.description: Start of the logs search time window.

time_to.description: End of the logs search time window.

sort.description: Sort order for log events by timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of log events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of log results.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key to deduplicate identical query executions.

Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when live reads exceed configured rate limits for the workspace/connection.

tool_schemas.name: list_hosts
tool_schemas.description: Lists Datadog hosts for the given workspace connection, fetching either directly from Datadog (source=live) or from our cached dd_resources hosts (source=cache), and returns up to limit results along with a cursor to retrieve the next page when more results are available. When source=cache, we apply filter/status/last_seen range and sort; when source=live, Datadog-backed filtering may be limited to query and pagination may follow Datadog semantics, so sort and some cache-only filters may be ignored. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, unsupported filter/sort combinations (e.g., cache-only fields with source=live) or malformed time ranges, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the workspace cannot access the connection, NOT_FOUND if the connection does not exist in the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when Datadog or this service rejects the request due to quota.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ddws_...) that owns the Datadog connection.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID (ddconn_...) to use for the request.

source.description: Whether to fetch directly from Datadog (live) or from the cached dd_resources table (cache).

query.description: Datadog host search query (e.g., tags, name fragments).

tags.description: Filter to hosts containing all of these tags.

status.description: Filter by cached status when source=cache.

last_seen_from.description: Only include hosts last seen at or after this time (cache-based).

last_seen_to.description: Only include hosts last seen at or before this time (cache-based).

sort.description: Sort order (cache-based; live sources may ignore).

limit.description: Maximum number of hosts to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for continuing a previous list call (from a prior response or cached query run).

tool_schemas.name: get_active_hosts_count
tool_schemas.description: Returns the total count of active hosts for the given time window, computed from Datadog when source=live or returned from an available cached dd_query_runs result when source=cache, using time_to (default: now) and time_from (default: 5 minutes before time_to). This endpoint returns a single aggregate count (not a paged list) and may return a cache-derived value when source=cache even if it is not real-time. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs or when time_from is after time_to, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the workspace cannot use the connection, NOT_FOUND if the connection is missing, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream or service quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ddws_...) that owns the Datadog connection.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID (ddconn_...) to use for the request.

time_from.description: Start of the time window; defaults to 5 minutes before time_to.

time_to.description: End of the time window; defaults to now.

source.description: Whether to compute via Datadog (live) or use a cached dd_query_runs result when available (cache).

tool_schemas.name: list_downtimes
tool_schemas.description: Lists Datadog downtimes for the given workspace connection, either live from Datadog or from cached dd_resources, returning up to limit downtimes and a cursor for pagination when more results exist. When source=cache we honor status/time/tag filters and sort; when source=live, Datadog-backed filtering/pagination is used and cache-only filters or sort may be ignored. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, malformed time filters, or incompatible filters for the chosen source, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient access to the connection, NOT_FOUND when the connection does not exist in the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when quota limits are hit.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ddws_...) that owns the Datadog connection.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID (ddconn_...) to use for the request.

source.description: Whether to fetch directly from Datadog (live) or from the cached dd_resources table (cache).

current_only.description: If true, only return downtimes active at time_to (or now).

status.description: Filter by cached status when source=cache.

time_from.description: Only include downtimes overlapping/after this time (best-effort; backend-specific).

time_to.description: Only include downtimes overlapping/before this time (best-effort; backend-specific).

tags.description: Filter to downtimes with matching scope/tags when source=cache.

sort.description: Sort order (cache-based; live sources may ignore).

limit.description: Maximum number of downtimes to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for continuing a previous list call (from a prior response or cached query run).

tool_schemas.name: schedule_downtime
tool_schemas.description: Schedules a Datadog downtime for the specified scope and start (with optional end, message, monitor targeting, timezone, and recurrence) and returns the created downtime details; repeated calls with the same idempotency_key return the same outcome without creating duplicates. We validate recurrence fields (type/period/week_days/until_date) and basic time ordering when end is provided, and pass supported fields through to Datadog. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid required fields, invalid time ranges, or unsupported recurrence combinations, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the workspace cannot mutate via the connection, NOT_FOUND if the connection is missing, CONFLICT if the idempotency_key is reused with different request parameters, and RATE_LIMITED when mutation quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ddws_...) that owns the Datadog connection.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID (ddconn_...) to use for the request.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to safely retry this mutation without duplicating effects.

scope.description: Datadog downtime scope, typically tags or host identifiers (e.g., ["host:i-123", "env:prod"]).

end.description: Downtime end time; omit for an open-ended downtime if supported.

message.description: Message to attach to the downtime.

monitor_id.description: Optional Datadog monitor id that this downtime applies to.

monitor_tags.description: Optional monitor tag filters for applying downtime to monitors.

recurrence.description: Optional recurrence configuration for repeating downtimes.

week_days.description: Days of week for weekly recurrences.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_downtime
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an existing Datadog downtime identified by either downtime_id (a cached dd_resources downtime) or datadog_downtime_id, and returns the cancellation result; repeated calls with the same idempotency_key are safe to retry and do not re-cancel or create side effects. If downtime_id is provided we verify it refers to a downtime resource and resolve it to the Datadog downtime identifier before cancelling. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when neither identifier is provided or IDs are malformed or downtime_id is not a downtime resource, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the workspace cannot mutate via the connection, NOT_FOUND if the connection is missing or the referenced downtime cannot be resolved, CONFLICT if the downtime is already cancelled/deleted or the idempotency_key is reused with different parameters, and RATE_LIMITED when cancellation quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ddws_...) that owns the Datadog connection.

connection_id.description: Datadog connection ULID (ddconn_...) to use for the request.

downtime_id.description: Cached downtime resource ULID (ddres_...) to cancel (resource_type=downtime).

datadog_downtime_id.description: Datadog downtime identifier to cancel (used when downtime_id is not provided).

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to safely retry this mutation without duplicating effects.

tool_schemas.name: create_datadog_connection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Datadog connection for the given workspace using the provided Datadog site and API/App keys, stores only credential hashes, verifies the credentials against Datadog, and returns the created connection record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, unsupported `site`, missing/empty keys, or cross-workspace references; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace; refuses with CONFLICT if a connection with the same name already exists in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to create the connection in.

name.description: Human-friendly name for this Datadog connection.

site.description: Datadog site to use for API calls.

api_key.description: Datadog API key (stored hashed; never returned).

app_key.description: Datadog APP key (stored hashed; never returned).

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Maximum outbound Datadog calls per minute allowed for this connection.

set_as_default.description: When true, sets this connection as the workspace default_datadog_connection_id.

tool_schemas.name: update_datadog_connection
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Datadog connection's mutable fields (name/site/credentials/rate limit) and/or transitions its `status` according to the lifecycle, optionally re-verifying credentials when keys/site change. Returns the updated connection record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, unsupported `site`, invalid lifecycle transitions, or empty keys; refuses with NOT_FOUND when workspace/connection is missing; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace; refuses with CONFLICT on name collisions in the same workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID owning the connection.

name.description: New display name for the connection.

site.description: New Datadog site for the connection.

api_key.description: New Datadog API key (stored hashed; never returned).

app_key.description: New Datadog APP key (stored hashed; never returned).

rate_limit_per_minute.description: New per-minute outbound call limit for this connection.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the connection status; invalid transitions are refused.

set_as_default.description: When true, sets this connection as the workspace default_datadog_connection_id.

verify_now.description: When true, performs a Datadog verification call and updates last_verified_at/last_error accordingly; if verification fails, status may be set to error.

tool_schemas.name: list_datadog_connections
tool_schemas.description: Lists Datadog connections for the given workspace with optional filtering by status and name query, returning up to `limit` items plus an opaque `cursor` when another page is available. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, enum values, malformed cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the workspace is missing; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list connections for.

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Updates a workspace's mutable fields and/or transitions its `status` according to the lifecycle, and returns the updated workspace record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, invalid lifecycle transitions, or referencing a default connection outside the workspace; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the workspace (or referenced connection) is missing; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to update.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the workspace status; invalid transitions are refused.

default_datadog_connection_id.description: Default Datadog connection ULID for this workspace.

tool_schemas.name: get_query_run
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single recorded query execution by id from `dd_query_runs` and returns its current status, timing, and persisted result/error without re-running the query. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the run does not exist in the workspace; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns the query run.
